🚀 v2.1.0 (Build 50): Notification Controls & Alert Silencing
• 🔔 Granular Notification Settings: Control Auto-SMS, Voice Agent, Appointments & Bypass alerts
• 🔇 Strict Mute Integrity: Bypassed & filtered alerts are automatically silenced when Auto-SMS or Voice Agent is turned off
• 🛠️ Settings Quick-Access: Access notification preferences directly from the AI Activity Feed
